title: Turtle Tide Peril
game_overview: Guide an agile sea turtle through treacherous polluted waters, dodging dense torrents of floating ocean garbage in an intense reflex survival test.
winning_condition: 在極高密度的海洋垃圾風暴中存活 60 秒（1分鐘），成功抵達潔淨海洋庇護所。
losing_condition: Lose all 5 health points by colliding with floating marine debris.

controls.input: 手指拖曳 / 滑鼠拖曳
controls.action: 直接按住並拖動海龜在海中靈活滑行，躲避密集的海洋垃圾。

controls.input: 方向鍵 / WASD / 虛擬搖桿
controls.action: 輔助八方向微調移動海龜。

controls.input: 空白鍵 / 點擊「衝刺」按鈕
controls.action: 釋放短暫無敵的龜殼衝刺技能（冷卻時間 3 秒）。

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Extreme Bullet-Hell Reflexes: Dense, dynamic hazard storms testing tight maneuverability. 2. Environmental Urgency: Vibrant marine aesthetics contrasting against stark artificial pollution. 3. Immediate Tactile Control: Direct finger-drag responsiveness paired with emergency Shell Dash mechanics.
sections.summary: Core guiding principles for gameplay and feel.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: The player pilots a sea turtle through deep ocean waters. Hazards (plastic bags, glass bottles, sharp straws, and ghost nets) spawn in increasingly dense, fast patterns. Players dodge trash to maintain their 5 HP, collect golden jellyfish for score multipliers, and grab clean oxygen bubbles for momentary shielding. As time elapses, garbage velocity and density spike exponentially until reaching the 180s Sanctuary threshold.

sections.title: Core Mechanics & Hazards
sections.content: 1. 5-Hit Armor System: The turtle starts with 5 HP; each debris collision subtracts 1 HP and triggers 1.5s invincibility flashing. 2. Hazard Spectrum: Floating Plastic Bags (swirling sinusoidal drift), Heavy Glass Bottles (rapid sinking vertical plunges), Plastic Straws (high-speed dart barrages), Ghost Nets (wide horizontal sweep lines requiring tight gap navigation). 3. Power Pickups: Oxygen Bubble (absorbs 1 hit) and Golden Jellyfish (bonus score & slight speed boost).

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Vertical (downward ocean current pushing debris from top to bottom, with horizontal cross-currents). Asset Orientation: Player turtle faces upward (12 o'clock default) with fluid tilt leaning towards movement direction. Movement Physics: Direct kinematic drag-following with smooth interpolation and slight inertial drift on keyboard/D-pad release. Camera: Full canvas playfield locked to view bounds.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer 1 (Background): Procedural deep turquoise-to-navy ocean gradient with soft caustic sunlight rays and drifting ambient micro-bubbles. Layer 2 (Playfield): Brightly saturated hazards with warning halos (white translucent bags, sharp green glass, neon yellow/pink straws, murky ghost nets) and the high-contrast player turtle. Layer 3 (HUD Overlay): Non-intrusive top-anchored 5-Heart health bar, survival timer, and score multiplier meter.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Red indicator beacons on the screen edge signaling incoming high-speed bottle drops or ghost net sweeps. State Change Juice: Bubble wake trails trailing from the turtle's flippers during dash, red screen vignette pulse on taking damage. Impact Juice: Tactile micro screen-shake on collision, water shockwave ripple upon collecting oxygen bubbles, and celebratory coral burst upon sanctuary victory.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Supports full native pointer drag directly on the turtle, alongside optional bottom-anchored Virtual D-Pad and Dash action button for mobile users. Buttons use touch-none CSS, pointer-events-auto on interactive elements, and robust pointerup/pointercancel event bindings to guarantee zero stuck states.
sections.summary: Mobile touch controls and direct drag integration.
